# Banana Intelligence

> Banana Intelligence is Nate Peace's app studio. We build small apps that make your day easier. 6 apps live.

## Products

- [DayStart](https://daystartai.app): a personalized morning briefing podcast for iPhone. Your top story, calendar, and weather in about five minutes. Free to try.
- [Plain Ballot](https://plainballot.com): a free, open source ballot guide. Every position is quoted exactly with its source; party labels stay hidden until asked; it never says how to vote. Agents can use its read-only MCP server at https://plainballot.com/mcp.
- [Artifact News](https://artifactnews.ai): one interactive piece a day, made from the news. A new piece goes up every morning at 9 a.m. Eastern, made from that morning's news, and every number in it comes with its source. Free on the web.
- [My Happenings](https://myhappenings.com) (beta): the news as a short show to hear or read, with new editions four times a day and every source listed.
- [Spooky Particles](https://spookyparticles.com): read-only alerts when an app you run on Vercel breaks. Checks every live site every 5 minutes.
- [Politicians by Jev](https://politiciansbyjev.vercel.app): ask a question and watch 100 famous politicians float or sink. Open source.

## Studio

- [How we build](https://bananaintelligence.ai/how-we-build/): one person and AI agents in parallel, a capped daily work block with a check that can fail, independent review, and a person's yes on anything public, any spend, and any account change.
- [Releases](https://bananaintelligence.ai/releases/): every public launch and major release of DayStart, Plain Ballot, and Artifact News, newest first, with the date, what shipped, and why.

## About

- [Nate Peace](https://natepeace.com): founder. Writes The Peace Process.
